# Roasting: see everything wrong before fixing anything, then survive reality

*Canonical template v2 (2026-11-27: rebuilt around the AI OS Iteration Suite, Wizard + Template form per [meta-template.md](./meta-template.md) §9). v1 synthesized 2026-10-27 by Evolver from three tellings of the roasting protocol, the roast-gate records, the strategy crash-test and the live roast of the game (Genealogy at the end). Newer Sasha-confirmed practice wins where tellings differ; older shapes stay as dated notes.*

> Button (= the result): «увидеть потенциал для роста!» (*translated:* "see the potential for growth!"); input: any artifact; icon idea (Sasha): a comedian roasting the audience. See [meta-template.md](./meta-template.md) §Console buttons (Sasha, 2026-11-26).

## 0. Wizard (run this; the rest is the template it fills)
| Step | Ask / do | Input | Output | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| W1 Object | What is being roasted, and at which level (artifact, strategy, build phase, live product, a template)? | the thing itself (text, file, screen, URL) | one line: object + level | the object is in front of the roaster, not described from memory |
| W2 Mode | Pick the mode from §3: Roast, Another round, Meta-roast, Crystallization, Crash-test, Meta-crash-test, 10x, Full cycle, Tone scan, Live roast, Build gate | W1 | mode named | the creator wants critique now (not comfort, not a fix) |
| W3 Energy | Read §2 aloud to yourself: loving, precise, no fixing yet | none | – | no "but" after praise; no wounding |
| W4 See | Run the mode. Default = Full cycle for anything that matters | W1 | the critique, then the next version only where the mode says so | every one of the 12 positions was held; watchdog passed (§4.4) |
| W5 Crystallize | Name the 27th: one irreversible move | W4 | one sentence + why | one action, executable now |
| W6 Record | Trace line + evolutionary record + «Template change: …» | W4–W5 | the next version and its record | the creator feels seen, energized, clear (the test, §2) |

Short form for a button: «увидеть потенциал для роста!» = W1 → Full cycle → W5 → W6.

## 1. Essence
"Don't fix. First, see clearly. Roast until the truth is undeniable. Only then — refine." Roasting is the **fidelity axis** (is this true to the essence?). The crash-test is the **viability axis** (does it survive real human behaviour?). A complete pass holds both (PST 93).

## 2. The energy (before any roast)
| Attacking | Loving |
|---|---|
| seeks to wound; invalidates ("neither X nor Y") | seeks to strengthen ("already X and Y, let's deepen each") |
| "but" after a compliment | "and" after a compliment |
| harsh words | precise words |

Two failures: **too harsh** (deflated creator) and **too soft** ("everything is already perfect, just amplify"; real errors missed). The middle: name errors clearly, without malice; suggest replacements, not just "amplify". **The test:** after reading, the creator feels seen, energized, clear on next steps. "If the roast makes you feel defensive — the roaster failed, not you."
> *Dated note:* the January prompts say "be fierce", "no mercy", "ruthlessly critique"; the later energy section (same protocol file) sets the canon: tough love, precise, never wounding.

## 3. The modes (the Iteration Suite, `/ai-os/iteration`; prompts verbatim in `src/modules/ai-os/AiOsPage.tsx` and `src/prompts/user/roastPrompts.ts`)
| Mode | What it does | Ends with |
|---|---|---|
| **Holonic seeing** | 4 quadrants (I · It · We · Its) × 3 depths (Essence ❤️ what IS it · Significance 🧠 why it matters · Consequences 🔥 what it results in) = 12 positions + the 13th (Sun Logos: what the whole sees that no single position caught). Think all 13, write one unified seeing | a whole picture, no verdict |
| **Roast the result** (perspectives 1–13) | the same 13 positions turned critical. «No fixing yet, just the roast.» | the critique |
| **Another round** (14–25) | the 13th is itself a holon: replay 4×3 on the first roast. Name the quadrant and depth it over-served (usually It / Its and Consequences) and LEAD with the under-explored ones (usually I / We and Essence) | the blind spots of round 1 |
| **Meta-roast** (26th, Meta-Logos) | roast the critique itself: projection, what it protected, what it over-emphasized, where too soft. «Instead of improving the answer, change the question.» | the deepest issue, often a new question or an acceptance test |
| **Crystallization** (27th, Si-Do shock) | not more analysis: the ONE specific, irreversible, inevitable action all 26 point to | «🔮 THE 27TH: [the move] · [why this one]» |
| **Crash-test** | assume it fails; the 12 hardest ways it dies, each a failure mode + **the exact stress signal that proves it is happening** | 12 rows: failure · signal |
| **Meta-crash-test** | crash-test the crash-test: «a true annihilation, and a Great Rebirth» | what survived the ashes, reborn |
| **10x** | the next version: absurd simplicity (Jobs), depth toward the whole truth, utmost usefulness; 10x without noise | the next version |
| **Full iteration cycle** | v1 → roast → meta-roast → v2 → roast → meta-roast → v3, then the quality check (§4.5) | v3 + its 27th |
| **Tone scan** (Angry-Dad Anti-Virus) | 6 distortion patterns (disguised directives, pushing urgency, hierarchy, conditional worth, self-shaming, fear); each passage: pattern, severity LOW/MED/HIGH, a clean reframe. Compass: read at 3 am, exhausted, would it feel pressured or seen? | flagged table + clean text |

## 4. How to run the cycle well
### 4.1 The fidelity cycle (v1)
1. **Roast 1:** every weakness, gap, vagueness, assumption. **No fixing.**
2. **Roast 2:** deeper: what did the first miss, what patterns repeat? Still no fixing.
3. **Meta-roast:** roast the roast: its biases, what it protected, was it too soft anywhere, the deepest issue not named. Still no fixing.
4. **Synthesis:** now, and only now, the next version: keep what was strong, fix what was weak, amplify the signal, cut the noise.
5. **Repeat** for **3 cycles** (3–5 for a person's Appleseed; 5+ is diminishing returns).

**Prompts that work** (Appleseed, verbatim): "Please roast this result from a place of tough love. What's generic? What's imprecise? Where did you play it safe?" → "Please continue roasting — no fixing or improving yet." → "Now please roast your own roast. Still no fixing or improvement. What did your critique miss?" → "Now with all of this constructive feedback, please produce the next iteration of the result."
**Signal integrity check after each cycle:** is the signal amplified? no new generic language? does the person recognize themselves (the ultimate test)?
**Lead with holonic seeing** when the object matters: see it from the 12 positions first, then roast; the meta-roast is the 26th (the seeing of the seeing).

### 4.2 The crash-test loop (viability axis, for strategies, offers, plans)
Loop three questions until the strategy stabilizes (PST 93c):
1. "What's our exact strategy in 1 short paragraph?" (actor, target, wedge, mechanism, outcome, immediate motion; make it as strong as possible before killing it)
2. "Let's subject it to the crash test. What's the post mortem of this exact strategy as is? Why and how did it fail?" Assume busy, defensive, under-resourced, skeptical humans; test urgency, trust, timing, willingness to pay, decision authority, self-language, proof, onboarding friction, follow-through, hidden dependence on the founder or on people being unusually brave. "Do not say 'it might fail.' Say why it died."
3. "Please look at the ashes. What survived the grand roast? What still holds true and has a seed of truth in it?"
End with the **evolutionary record**: "This strategy was really about [surviving seed], but it failed because [core death mechanism], so the next iteration should [next sharper move]."
**Stop signal: kinetic calm**, not certainty: small enough to try, real enough to matter.

### 4.3 Roast gates in a build (product, architecture, UI)
Between phases, a gate: **walkthrough first, no fixing** (trace the flow / every navigation path / screenshot the set) → **cycle 1** (usability, hierarchy, one action per screen) → **cycle 2** (edge cases, copy, emotional flow; back, refresh, failure) → **cycle 3, meta** (what did 1–2 miss? hidden assumptions?) → **synthesis** split into *must fix before the next phase* and *v1 scope: defer, named*. (Daily-loop roasts, 2026-01-27, are the worked records.)


### 4.4 Watchdog (AI blind spot)
Before finishing any roast: did it over-index on It (mechanics) and Its (system) and under-index on I (does it feel true from inside?) and We (does the tribe see itself?) Most AI defaults to fixing mechanics. **Mi-Fa check:** were the uncomfortable positions actually held, not only listed? The shock is love: holding all 12 without collapsing any.

### 4.5 Quality check of the next version
□ Feels true from the inside (I ❤️) □ works mechanically (It ❤️) □ the tribe recognizes itself (We ❤️) □ serves the system at scale (Its ❤️) □ the center holds (13th) □ all positions held with love (Mi-Fa) □ the 27th was executed, not only named.

## 5. The live roast (after a publish)
Sequence (2026-10-27, AI OS Iterate suite): **holonic seeing → roast → second roast → meta-roast → 12 crash-tests → next version.** Findings become work packages. The strongest move is the meta-roast changing the question: from «does each screen look right?» to «can a stranger walk title → test → saved character → village in three minutes without a wall?» **That walk became the acceptance test for every publish.** Rule from it: a meta-roast should end in one acceptance test, not only in more findings.

## 6. In software (one button, many calls)
The user sees one button and a "wow"; under it: generate v1 → roast 1 → roast 2 → meta → v2, three times (15+ calls). Variants: hidden (server-side), on request ("Refine"), or visible (the sections update as the person watches). Productized in `deepen-icp`, `deepen-tp`, `deepen-pain` and the Appleseed pipeline.

## 7. Where it applies
Everything generative: Appleseed, Excalibur, ICP, Promise, Pain, landing copy, positioning, channel strategy, specs (the self-roast after decisions: weaknesses become constraints), and the roast itself. "It's fractal."
